text:
Predicates:
WildTurkey(x) ::: x is a type of wild turkey.
Eastern(x) ::: x is an Eastern wild turkey.
Osceola(x) ::: x is an Osceola wild turkey.
Gould(x) ::: x is a Gould's wild turkey.
Merriam(x) ::: x is a Merriam's wild turkey.
RioGrande(x) ::: x is a Rio Grande wild turkey.
Ocellated(x) ::: x is an Ocellated wild turkey.
Tom ::: Tom is a wild turkey.

Premises:
WildTurkey(EasternWildTurkey) ∧ WildTurkey(OsceolaWildTurkey) ∧ WildTurkey(GouldWildTurkey) ∧ WildTurkey(MerriamWildTurkey) ∧ WildTurkey(RioGrandeWildTurkey) ∧ WildTurkey(OcellatedWildTurkey) ::: There are six types of wild turkeys: Eastern wild turkey, Osceola wild turkey, Gould’s wild turkey, Merriam’s wild turkey, Rio Grande wild turkey, and Ocellated wild turkey.
¬Eastern(Tom) ::: Tom is not an Eastern wild turkey.
¬Osceola(Tom) ::: Tom is not an Osceola wild turkey.
¬(Gould(Tom) ∨ Merriam(Tom) ∨ RioGrande(Tom)) ::: Tom is also not a Gould's wild turkey, or a Merriam's wild turkey, or a Rio Grande wild turkey.
WildTurkey(Tom) ::: Tom is a wild turkey.

Conclusion:
¬Ocellated(Tom) ::: Tom is not an Ocellated wild turkey.
